about: The monsters, spirits and fighting objects Westernesse knows, by their base kind (see animals.json for what a record holds). The type temperaments below are how a monster meets a company when its own record says nothing. Species: kinds of creature statted by their own nature rather than by an adventuring class. type is the creature classification; traits are nature traits that carry mechanics. statistics give the natural weapon and armour (Orsino weapon and armour entries), the hit die and a fixed or rolled stat line. A variant names its base species with variantOf and overrides only the fields it declares. A species creature has no class.

temperaments.about: How a monster meets a company that comes where it lives, when its species does not say (an animal without its own temperament has none): beasts and elementals hold their ground, the dead and demons fall on the living, aberrations lie in wait, constructs keep their posts, dragons name a price, the fey slip away, celestials defend.
